articles.text:
Melhor TV TCL: 8 modelos para comprar em 2026
Encontre a melhor TV TCL para sua casa ou escritório; lista reúne modelos 4K, QLED e MiniLED com ótima qualidade de imagem e bom custo-benefício
Escolher a melhor TV TCL em 2026 requer avaliar critérios como resolução e tecnologia do painel, sistema de áudio integrado, tamanho da tela, conexões disponíveis e recursos de processamento de imagem.
Entre os destaques, estão smart TVs 4K com bom custo-benefício, e os modelos com painéis MiniLED, que entregam maior controle de iluminação e contrastes aprimorados em relação às TVs de LED tradicionais.
A seguir, confira nossa lista com 10 modelos de TVs TCL que valem a pena em 2026. Analisamos as principais características para te ajudar a decidir qual é a televisão ideal para você.
A TCL C7L é uma TV 4K disponível nos tamanhos de 65″ e 75″. Com painel SQD-MiniLED e brilho HDR declarado de até 3.000 nits, o televisor é uma alternativa para quem exige boa precisão no controle de iluminação e cores.
O SQD-MiniLED combina pontos quânticos e pequenos LEDs para controlar a luz por zonas e ampliar o contraste. O brilho elevado em nits pode favorecer a visualização de destaques em conteúdos HDR, embora o resultado também dependa do conteúdo reproduzido pelo aparelho.
A C7L também contempla jogos e esportes, com recursos de atualização variável e um modo Game Accelerator anunciado em até 288 Hz. Entre os recursos de conectividade estão: HDMI 1.4, HDMI 2.0 e HDMI 2.1, além de Wi-Fi 5 e Bluetooth 5.4.
A TCL C6K também é uma TV MiniLED com resolução 4K, mas está disponível em mais tamanhos: 55″, 65″, 75″, 85″ e 98 polegadas.
Os pontos quânticos do painel melhoram as cores e os LEDs menores permitem controle localizado da luz de fundo. A fabricante anuncia controle de iluminação em até 512 zonas, brilho voltado à reprodução de HDR e processador AiPQ Pro.
Nas versões de 85″ e 98 polegadas, a tela Matte HVA tem acabamento fosco para reduzir reflexos de luz ambiente, importante para salas com janelas ou luminárias próximas à tela. O modelo é compatível com HDMI 2.1 de alta velocidade, além de permitir a conexão de dispositivos Bluetooth (5.4).
A TCL X11L é a linha mais avançada em tecnologia de imagem para filmes e séries, com painel SQD-MiniLED e controle localizado da iluminação, mas está disponível apenas em 85″ e 98 polegadas. A TV combina o brilho do MiniLED com a reprodução de cores do Super QLED.
A retroiluminação dividida em zonas controladas individualmente preserva o contraste entre áreas claras e escuras na mesma cena. A TCL informa brilho máximo de até 10.000 nits em HDR e até 20.736 zonas de iluminação no modelo de 98 polegadas.
Para jogos e cenas de movimento rápido, a linha oferece atualização de até 144 Hz em 4K, com VRR, além de um modo de até 288 Hz. A TCL não informa a quantidade de entradas HDMI disponíveis, mas a TV traz conexão Wi-Fi e Bluetooth 5.4.
A TCL P8L é voltada a quem procura uma tela grande com recursos para jogos. A linha aparece no varejo brasileiro nos tamanhos de 75″, 85″ e 98 polegadas.
A resolução 4K e a tecnologia de pontos quânticos são combinadas ao painel HVA, enquanto o controle de iluminação contribui para um contraste mais definido. A fabricante informa suporte a VRR, atualização de até 144 Hz para videogames, Bluetooth 5.4 e quatro portas HDMI.
O sistema de áudio Onkyo 2.1 com subwoofer integrado é outro ponto central da linha, acompanhado de suporte a Dolby Atmos e DTS Virtual:X que aprimoram a qualidade do som. É uma opção a considerar em salas amplas, sobretudo para quem deseja combinar tela grande, jogos e áudio integrado de maior qualidade.
A TCL P7L é uma TV de entrada para quem busca tecnologia QLED, priorizando a reprodução de cores e o uso cotidiano de streaming, filmes e transmissões esportivas. Ela está disponível em 50″, 55″, 65″, 75″ e 85 polegadas, com três portas HDMI, além de Wi-Fi, Bluetooth e USB.
Os pontos quânticos ampliam a gama de cores em relação aos modelos LCD convencionais e o processador AiPQ é responsável por recursos de tratamento de imagem, incluindo ajustes de nitidez e cor.
A linha é compatível com Dolby Vision e HDR10+, o que permite reproduzir conteúdos nesses padrões quando a fonte oferece suporte. Para jogos, a TCL anuncia recursos de até 120 Hz DLG/VRR, mas a frequência e as condições disponíveis variam conforme o dispositivos e o modo de jogo utilizado.
A TCL T6C é uma TV QLED 4K para quem busca cores ampliadas e suporte a formatos modernos de imagem sem necessariamente partir para uma linha MiniLED. Ela está disponível em 55″, 65″ e 75 polegadas, e sua tela HVA utiliza a estrutura LCD para formar a imagem.
O processador AiPQ ajusta nitidez, cor, contraste e movimento. O modelo suporta Dolby Vision e HDR10+ e a TCL informa taxa nativa de 60 Hz nos modelos da linha, além de um modo Game Accelerator com VRR anunciado em até 120 Hz, emulado por software.
O áudio é de dois canais com suporte a Dolby Atmos, e o Google TV concentra os principais aplicativos de entretenimento via Play Store — assim como nos outros modelos. A TV ainda suporta HDMI 2.1 de alta velocidade para jogos e conteúdos em alta definição.
A TCL S5K atende a quem procura uma smart TV de dimensões menores para quartos, cozinhas ou ambientes compactos. A linha está disponível em 32″, 40″ e 43 polegadas e combina tecnologia QLED com resolução Full HD, inferior em qualidade em comparação com modelos 4K.
A S5K também oferece compatibilidade com HDR10 e Dolby Audio, além de modos de exibição voltados a diferentes tipos de conteúdo, como filmes, esportes e jogos. Essa versão trás apenas duas portas HDMI, mas se conecta via Bluetooth e Wi-Fi.
Seu foco é o consumo cotidiano de streaming e televisão em ambientes nos quais uma tela de 32 a 43 polegadas seja suficiente, sem a proposta de recursos avançados de jogos encontrada nas famílias MiniLED de porte maior.
A TCL A400M combina uma proposta de design com recursos de imagem de uma TV QD-MiniLED. A linha está disponível em 55″, 6″5, 75″, 85″ e 98 polegadas, com estrutura fina e traseira plana pensado para facilitar a integração visual ao ambiente.
A proposta é unir uma tela que pode ser instalada como parte da decoração a uma tecnologia de iluminação mais avançada do que a retroiluminação LED convencional.
Para jogos, a A400M oferece atualização de até 144 Hz com VRR e um modo DLG anunciado em até 288 Hz, que depende de sinal e configuração compatíveis. Ao todo, são quatro portas HDMI, duas entradas USB, além de conexão Wi-Fi e Bluetooth.
Para escolher uma TV TCL, considere os seguintes aspectos:
A TCL C6K é uma escolha equilibrada para TV custo-benefício por trazer tecnologia QD-MiniLED, até 144 Hz com VRR, Google TV e sistema de áudio ONKYO 2.1. Ela reúne recursos de imagem e jogos encontrados em linhas mais avançadas, sem ter um preço tão elevado no mercado brasileiro.
A TCL C7L é a melhor smart TV para jogos da marca, com ampla conectividade e tecnologias de sincronização, o que inclui HDMI 2.1, VRR (Taxa de Atualização Variável), ALLM (Modo de Baixa Latência Automático) e suporte a AMD FreeSync (e FreeSync Premium Pro).
Além disso, ela traz taxa de atualização nativa de 144 Hz em 4K e chega a 288 Hz em Full HD através do modo Game Accelerator (ideal para PCs potentes).
A TCL S5K é uma das melhores TVs de 32 polegadas, sendo indicada para quartos pequenos. A linha oferece tecnologia QLED, Google TV, Google Cast e Dolby Audio, recursos adequados para streaming e televisão no dia a dia, sem exagerar no tamanho.
Sim. A TCL é uma fabricante global de televisores que oferece modelos de diferentes faixas de preço e tecnologias, desde TVs QLED de entrada até aparelhos QD-MiniLED com recursos avançados para jogos.
A principal vantagem é a variedade de configurações, que permite escolher de acordo com o orçamento e o uso. Ainda assim, vale verificar a qualidade específica do painel, os recursos de software de cada modelo, a garantia e a assistência técnica disponível.
Não existe uma vencedora absoluta entre TCL, Samsung e LG, já que a escolha depende da tecnologia de imagem, dos recursos e do preço de cada modelo.
A TCL oferece opções com painéis QLED e MiniLED, incluindo TVs com telas grandes e taxas de atualização elevadas. Já as TVs Samsung contam com tecnologias como QLED, Neo QLED e OLED, além de sistema operacional Tizen que tem suas particularidades.
A LG também oferece modelos com painel de alta tecnologia, com recursos de inteligência artificial e funções voltadas a streaming e jogos. Para escolher, compare aparelhos de tamanhos e faixas de preço semelhantes, considerando as especificações e os recursos que melhor atendem às suas necessidades.
A TCL é uma empresa chinesa de tecnologia fundada em 1981, especializada em televisores, painéis de imagem e outros eletrônicos. No Brasil, a operação da marca é formada pela parceria entre a TCL e a brasileira SEMP. O grupo desenvolve e fabrica televisores e atua em diferentes mercados internacionais.
Não. TCL e Toshiba são marcas distintas, com histórias e estruturas empresariais próprias. No Brasil, a TCL tem ligação com a SEMP, empresa tradicional do setor de eletrônicos.
Por isso, ao pesquisar a melhor TV SEMP, é importante avaliar os modelos comercializados sob essa marca separadamente dos aparelhos TCL. Embora as empresas já tenham estabelecido parcerias comerciais, isso não significa que sejam a mesma companhia.
As TVs TCL utilizam o Google TV, sistema que organiza aplicativos, recomendações e conteúdos de diferentes serviços em uma única interface. Ele oferece integração com o Google Assistente em modelos compatíveis e recursos de transmissão de conteúdo por meio do Google Cast.
Nas TVs TCL, é possível encontrar aplicativos comuns no Brasil, como Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Globoplay e Spotify, além de outras opções disponíveis na loja de aplicativos. O catálogo pode variar conforme a região, a versão do sistema e a compatibilidade de cada serviço.
Sim. Os modelos TCL equipados com Google TV oferecem acesso à Google Play Store para baixar aplicativos compatíveis diretamente no televisor. Porém, nem todos os aplicativos disponíveis para celulares Android podem ser instalados na TV, pois precisam ter compatibilidade com a plataforma.
Sim. Você pode usar o aplicativo Google TV ou o TCL Home para controlar funções da televisão pelo celular. Também é possível transmitir vídeos e outros conteúdos de aplicativos compatíveis usando o Google Cast. Em geral, o celular e a TV precisam estar conectados à mesma rede Wi-Fi para utilizar esses recursos.

articles.title: 'AI is pervasive, it is everywhere': Microsoft boasts about AI turbocharging Windows 11 development, and users aren't surprised — but they're worried about bugs
articles.text:
Windows 11's new internet speed test was built in a flash by agentic AI — which is both impressive and worrying
Users worry that AI is being used with 'woefully insufficient human oversight'
- Windows 11 just got a revamped internet speed test in preview
- This feature was shuttled swiftly through development using agentic AI in combination with human oversight
- Microsoft boasts that this is about: "Getting from idea to customer value faster. Without AI slop." Others are more cynical, though
Windows 11 just got a useful change in preview, with its built-in internet speed test being revamped, and the new version was produced using AI (in conjunction with human oversight, I should add).
Windows Latest spotted that Marcus Ash, Microsoft's VP of Windows Design and Research, posted on X to explain that the "team moved pretty fast on this one", adding that following feedback asking for the speed test to be improved, "within a day, Diego had a working prototype." (Diego Baca is VP of Design for Windows).
Ash tells us: "From there, our connectivity team worked with partners to bring the experience into Windows. The design and build work was driven by an agentic AI workflow, with a person guiding the process in their spare time."
The Microsoft exec further explains that this is where he sees "a lot of potential in AI" and using agentic workflows, in terms of "Getting from idea to customer value faster. Without AI slop. That is the way."
Analysis: AI, oversight, bugs, and jobs
Of course, this is a controversial topic. Mention AI being involved in the coding of Windows 11 and some tempers will flare online, even though we know this is happening anyway. Microsoft has made no secret of that fact.
Indeed, among the AI hate and flames on social media, a lot of people are point out that these days pretty much all software is being developed in conjunction with Large Language Models (LLM agents) — even Linux.
As one Redditor makes clear: "Newsflash — every single piece of software you use, except for open source projects that are making a statement, you should expect to have AI written code in it. It is pervasive, it is everywhere."
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
The key aspect here is exactly how the AI agent in question is employed.
It's one thing for such an agent to be given a task to write a piece of code for a certain feature, and then just to slap that into your software or operating system as it is (or maybe after a cursory glance through the work). It's another thing to have a human programmer working on a feature and using an agent to perform grunt-work (easy but perhaps time-consuming) coding therein — and then to properly check the AI's output.
Theoretically, there's nothing wrong with the latter approach, at least in terms of the soundness of the coding work. And as Microsoft's Ash points out, this is really accelerating development times — meaning Windows 11 users will get new features (hopefully capabilities they want, like this improved internet speed test) much more swiftly. Which is exactly why almost every developer is now utilizing this tech.
There are problems here, though, and they're bound up in the public perception of Microsoft. Do Windows 11 users trust the company to be using AI in the right — i.e., properly checked and vetted — way? Not really, in many cases, as there remains a lot of doubt over the overall quality of Windows 11 code, and rightly so given the regularity, and severity, of the bugs we've seen (with more prevalence since 2024, and that 24H2 update).
As another Redditor observes: "People aren't calling Windows slop because it's being made using AI these days. They're calling it slop because it's being made using AI with woefully insufficient human oversight and even more woefully insufficient QA, leading to repeated disastrous bugs making it to production and end users being treated as beta testers. You want people to stop calling your product slop? Stop shipping updates that take down people's computers or break existing features."
The other issue here is that of AI stealing coding jobs from people. Agents may make things happen a lot more quickly, but as Ash notes, this revamped speed test was implemented mainly by an agent — including its design — with the software engineer "guiding the process in their spare time", making it sound like a rather casual amount of effort on the human side of the equation.
Is it a particularly sensitive approach to be touting the benefits of AI — as real as they may be for an operating system's ongoing development and maintenance — in this way at a time when Microsoft has been swinging the axe with various job cuts and pushing staff towards voluntary redundancy in a big way? I'd suggest it isn't, and the timing of this particular push of the value of agentic AI is dubious in that respect.
At least in this case Microsoft is being upfront and transparent about what it's doing — and we can expect a good deal more AI acceleration of Windows 11's development going forward.

Triple your Nintendo Switch 2's storage for just $99 — save $50 on this ultra-fast 512GB Samsung P9 microSD card for a limited-time only
Boosting storage without a huge price tag
As prices soar, you'll want to pick up a bargain on storage when you can find it. For a limited time only, you can pick up a 512GB Samsung P9 microSD Express card for just $99.99 at Amazon. This price brings it back down to its original MSRP and means you're saving $50 compared to its current list price. This is the perfect option for a Nintendo Switch 2 owner looking to boost their storage for new games.
● Check out this Samsung deal at Amazon
The Samsung P9 is one of the best microSD Express cards you can buy right now, delivering ultra-fast sequential read speeds of up to 800 MB/s. Those speeds mean it's a great option for installing games and playing them on your Switch 2 without gameplay lag. Write speeds aren't shared, but in this class and capacity, you can usually expect up to 300 MB/s.
The Samsung P9 is a microSD Express card that offers great performance and reliability for its price. The 512GB model is currently priced at its original MSRP of $99.99.
You'll want the highest possible write speeds, but for a Switch 2 owner, 300 MB/s is still going to be fast enough to install new games and updates without huge waiting times. The high speeds you're seeing here will mean you won't have too big a bottleneck compared to installing directly onto the Switch 2's internal storage.
That said, these speeds make the Samsung P9 Express up to four times faster than a typical UHS-I microSD card. It also ships with features to help get the most out of your card, including Host Memory Buffer (HMB) functionality to help improve data transfer speeds, along with Dynamic Thermal Guard (DTG) support to help stop the card from overheating and limiting its performance.
microSD cards are small, so durability is an issue to think about, especially if you're handling it often. Samsung reckons this is a model that's well protected, even if you drop it in water, along with protection against extreme temperatures and even X-ray exposure. It has a 3-year limited warranty, and it supports Samsung's Magician software, so you can keep an eye on the card's health, as well as check if it's genuine or not (although that's not an issue here).
The Switch 2 is one of the first consoles to include microSD Express support, so you can use this Samsung P9 Express card's faster storage speeds compared to older UHS-I cards. The $99.99 sale price makes this 512GB Samsung P9 a brilliant bargain to pick up ahead of the holiday season, especially if you're a current or soon-to-be Switch 2 owner. It'll give you a quick-and-easy storage upgrade ahead of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remaster launching later this week, too.

articles.title: Las bodas están llegando a tal extremo de desbarre que ya empiezan a tener su propio podcast para la ocasión
articles.text:
Hace tiempo que casarse va más allá de encontrar un lugar, celebrar el banquete y reunir a familiares y amigos. Tenemos una auténtica industria donde cada detalle se convierte en un servicio. Además, si los novios quieren atesorar recuerdos del enlace parece que ya no basta con recurrir a fotógrafos, videógrafos o los clásicos libros de firmas. Ahora, el universo nupcial suma una nueva forma de conservar hasta el último comentario de amigos y familiares: un podcast en tu boda.
La propuesta es habilitar un espacio el día de tu celebración con sofá, cámara, micrófonos e iluminación donde tendrás a tu propio host de podcast entrevistando y haciendo juegos o preguntas a tus familiares y amigos. Desgranando anécdotas de vuestra infancia o con mensajes emotivos para el futuro matrimonio, tus invitados se sentirán durante unos minutos como los protagonistas de un talk show.
Países como Estados Unidos, Chile, Portugal o México ya cuentan con esta propuesta y en España ya empieza también a abrirse camino. En nuestro país contratarlo puede costar alrededor de 1500 euros pero, como suele ocurrir en el mundo de las bodas, todo depende del proveedor y de los servicios que se incluyan.
Esta idea no podría encajar más con este continuo abanico de posibilidades (y gastos) que surgen durante la organización de un enlace. Transformar una celebración en una experiencia donde lo esencial es la personalización, es una de las bazas de una industria que no deja de ofrecer nuevas propuestas.
Una factura final que no para de crecer
Hace años la figura del wedding planner podía resultar ajena o incluso extravagante. Hoy en día, organizar una celebración de este tipo implica tal número de decisiones que contar con un profesional que te ayude a coordinarlo todo puede ser una de las primeras opciones que barajen los novios. Y es que, más allá de elegir vestido o traje, el lugar de la ceremonia y el banquete, hay multitud de detalles que planificar: el transporte para los invitados, estética de la boda, la música de la ceremonia, la música de entrada al banquete, la del baile nupcial, manteleria, vajilla, adornos florales, disposición de las mesas, tipo de barra libre, regalos…
A estas decisiones tenemos que sumarle una larga lista de extras con los que personalizar la celebración. Fotomatones, cámara 360, glitter bar, estación de tatuajes (tanto permanentes como temporales), mesa dulce… Incluso para el baile de los novios puedes adquirir packs nupciales en escuelas de baile, y convertirlo en una experiencia de meses y varias clases con los que sorprender a tus invitados con una coreografía especial para ese momento.
Todas estas y muchas otras propuestas amplían las posibilidades de personalizar vuestro día, pero también incrementan la factura final. La media actual para una boda en España se encuentra entre 30.000 y 50.000 euros para 100 o 150 invitados y según el informe del sector nupcial de 2026 de Bodas.net el coste medio por invitado es de 225 euros. Además, el 45% de las parejas encuestadas superó el presupuesto que tenían previsto para la celebración.
No solo tienes que cuadrar fechas e invitados, cada nuevo servicio es una decisión económica más. Un extra puede no representar un gran desembolso por separado, pero la suma de varias propuestas sí que tienen un impacto en el presupuesto global. Contratar a un artista que haga una ilustración en directo o instalar un teléfono para que los invitados puedan dejar grabado un mensaje para los novios puede tener un valor sentimental y estar perfectamente justificado, pero no deja de ser un negocio para las empresas y un incremento en el presupuesto con el que quizá no contabas al iniciar el proceso.
Una boda, tu contenido “orgánico”
Las redes sociales también juegan un papel crucial en dar a conocer todos estos servicios y en la forma que compartimos y recordamos una unión. Es más, cada vez es más común encontrarse con profesionales que producen contenido específicamente para redes sociales durante la boda. Lo que anteriormente era trabajo de amigos y familiares, ahora corre a cargo del wedding content creator, un profesional que graba los preparativos, los momentos espontáneos, detalles concretos o reacciones de invitados con el móvil en formato vertical, perfecto para Instagram o Tiktok y que tienes al momento o cuestión de pocas horas.
Ya no hace falta esperar unas semanas por las fotografías profesionales editadas o conformarse con el TikTok de tu amigo enseñando lo que come en tu boda; el reclamo es una figura que organice y capture todo el contenido “orgánico” que tiene que nacer de ese día. Esto ilustra hasta qué punto construimos ese recuerdo digital. Por eso, formatos como el podcast no es algo que resulte antinatural en este tipo de celebración.
Al fin y al cabo lleva años formando parte del consumo digital y es parte del lenguaje de las redes sociales. No solo hablamos de escuchar podcast en plataformas especializadas o de ver entrevistas en Youtube. Si echamos un vistazo en Instagram o Tiktok encontramos como algunos influencers o creadores de contenido reproducen esa estética de entrevista de podcast, incluso cuando nadie les está haciendo preguntas.
Así que montar tu propio set en ese día único no es algo disparatado. No estamos recopilando lo que sucede en la celebración sino que incita a los propios invitados a participar, conformando una forma diferente de conservar. No sólo es lo que ocurrió, sino también lo que las personas que acompañaban a los novios pensaban o sentían durante ese día. Además, las entrevistas o proponer juegos durante esa grabación produce unos recuerdos o situaciones espontáneas muy difíciles de replicar con otros formatos, fruto esa mezcla de entretenimiento y creación de recuerdos.
Podemos cuestionar que una celebración se convierta en una máquina de crear contenido, pero el componente sentimental de muchos de estos extras es innegable. Poder escuchar el mensaje de tus abuelos grabado o volver a ver como tus amigos cuentan la historia de cómo os conocisteis puede tener un valor emocional incalculable. Y la industria nupcial es consciente de ello, razón por la que detectan que esa necesidad de conservar los recuerdos es un nicho de mercado, y lo convierten en una nueva oportunidad de negocio.
Incluso teniendo cierto sentido esto del podcast nupcial, y sin dejar de contar con ciertas ventajas frente a otros productos mucho más hijos de su tiempo como la cámara 360, hay un riesgo en esta hiperpersonalización de las bodas. Los enlaces, como sucede con la moda o las redes sociales, también siguen las tendencias y en pocos meses pueden quedarse desfasadas. Si tenemos en cuenta la antelación con la que se recomienda organizar ese día y la rapidez con la que se acumulan los “imprescindibles” para tu celebración, puede que cuando veamos el evento en retrospectiva, ciertos añadidos terminen siendo una nota discordante. Por ello, lo mejor es dejarse llevar por aquello que realmente encaje con cada pareja en lugar de intentar estar al día de cada novedad. 
En Xataka | España lleva tiempo sumida en una revolución silenciosa que está cambiando su sociedad: la soltería

articles.title: Plus de 100 frigos de supermarchés ont été piratés à travers l'Europe, des montagnes de nourritures jetées
articles.text:
Mise à jour du 3 novembre 2026
La cyberattaque sur les frigos de supermarchés s’étend à plusieurs pays d’Europe, en plus de la Belgique, du Luxembourg et de la Suède. Des rapports évoquant des incidents analogues proviennent actuellement de l’Italie, du Portugal, de la Finlande, de l’Estonie, de l’Irlande et des Pays-Bas. Reuters parle de plus de 100 magasins touchés à travers l’Europe, dont près de la moitié se trouvent en Belgique. Le parquet fédéral belge a ouvert une enquête pénale pour tenter d’identifier les hackers. Selon ICA, l’un des principaux groupes de distribution alimentaire de Suède, tous les magasins touchés utilisaient un système de contrôle fourni par Danfoss, le même fabricant que lors de l’attaque en France.
—————————————————————————————————————————————————-
Dans la nuit du dimanche 1ᵉʳ au lundi 2 novembre 2026, des pirates ont pris le contrôle à distance des installations frigorifiques de plusieurs supermarchés belges, rapporte l’agence Belga. Les attaquants ont activé le mode dégivrage des installations. De facto, la température s’est mise à grimper dans les frigos et les congélateurs, mettant en danger les denrées qui y sont stockées.
Des dizaines de magasins touchés
Dès que le bug a été repéré, Sabcobel, une entreprise spécialisée dans l’installation de systèmes de réfrigération, a mobilisé ses techniciens au beau milieu de la nuit. Stephan Moelans, PDG de Sabcobel, explique avoir « passé toute la nuit et la matinée à déconnecter du réseau les installations touchées ». Dans le sillage de Sabcobel, la chaîne de supermarchés Delhaize a prévenu les gérants de ses magasins de la cyberattaque. Dans certains magasins, la température des frigos et des surgélateurs avait grimpé jusqu’à 15 °C. Pour sauver leurs stocks, certains responsables ont fait appel de toute urgence à des camions frigorifiques.
Selon Delhaize, l’« incident informatique » a touché les réfrigérateurs et les congélateurs de dizaines de ses supermarchés en Belgique et au Luxembourg. D’autres enseignes font aussi partie des victimes. Des magasins Carrefour, cinq supérettes Spar et certains magasins Ikea sont aussi touchés. Sabcobel recense à lui une vingtaine d’installations piratées.
Au sein de nombreux magasins, la chaîne du froid a été rompue. Des produits frais et des aliments surgelés ont donc été jetés, par mesure de précaution. La Belgique n’est pas le seul pays visé par l’attaque. En Suède, les enseignes ICA et Coop ont signalé des incidents similaires. Dans un magasin suédois, la température des frigos a même dépassé les 50 °C.
À lire aussi : « La partie émergée d’un iceberg » : après les frigos, quels appareils risquent aussi de se faire pirater ?
Le même scénario qu’en France
Le scénario rappelle étrangement la cyberattaque qui a frappé la France il y a seulement trois semaines. Dans la nuit du 11 au 12 octobre, des pirates ont en effet pris le contrôle des systèmes de réfrigération de centaines de supermarchés, dont Intermarché, Super U et Leclerc. Les températures étaient montées jusqu’à 50 °C, obligeant les géants de la grande distribution à se débarrasser d’une montagne d’aliments. Les pertes se sont chiffrées en dizaines de millions d’euros.
Comme le souligne le PDG de Sabcobel, les pirates ont utilisé « exactement le même mécanisme » en Belgique, à savoir le dégivrage forcé des installations frigorifiques. Tout porte donc à croire que c’est l’exemple français qui a inspiré les hackers qui ont frappé la Belgique.
« Pour les enseignes, le risque principal est la réplication : la méthode est publique, peu coûteuse, et le parc d’équipements vulnérables ne sera pas remplacé en quelques semaines », prévenait d’ailleurs Samuel Hassine, PDG de Filigran, dans un commentaire transmis à 01net, quelques heures après la cyberattaque en France.
En France, l’ANSSI a établi que l’attaque ne reposait pas sur une faille sophistiquée, mais sur des « défauts de sécurisation élémentaires ». En clair, les équipements étaient exposés directement sur Internet et protégés par des mots de passe faibles, faciles à deviner. C’est pourquoi on estime que la cyberattaque a pu être initiée par des hackers peu aguerris, armés de l’IA. Actuellement, les frigoristes belges tentent de colmater les brèches pour éviter un autre incident. Pour Stephan Moelans, « la solution la plus simple consiste à gérer les réfrigérateurs via une connexion Internet sécurisée ». C’est d’ailleurs la solution adoptée par la plupart des clients du groupe en France dans le sillage de l’attaque nationale du mois dernier.

articles.title: Ambani tops Forbes' global billionaire gainers list with $7B wealth jump as Reliance shares soar
articles.text:
Ambani tops Forbes' global billionaire gainers list with $7B wealth jump as Reliance shares soar
The gains pushed Ambani to No.23 spot on the world billionaire list, making him the richest Indian ahead of Gautam Adani, who was ranked at No.26.
Reliance Industries chairman Mukesh Ambani has emerged as the world's biggest billionaire wealth gainer, adding over $6 billion to his fortune in a single day, as shares of his flagship company surged following a stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings performance.
According to Forbes' Real-Time Billionaires list, Ambani's wealth increased by 7.85%, or $6.3 billion, making him the biggest gainer globally in the latest update to the ranking on November 2.
The gain was substantially ahead of the second-biggest wealth accretion on the list, with Spanish retail billionaire Amancio Ortega adding $1.7 billion, followed by China's Zhong Shanshan at $1.5 billion.
The gains pushed Ambani to No.23 spot on the world billionaire list, making him the richest Indian ahead of Gautam Adani, who was ranked at No.26 with a wealth of $79.12 billion, according to the Forbes listing. Ambani had a wealth of $88.8 billion, according to Forbes.
The sharp increase in Ambani's wealth coincided with a rally in Reliance Industries shares, which jumped 11.6% on Monday, marking their strongest trading session in more than six years. The stock closed at its day's high and was the biggest gainer on the benchmark Nifty 50 index.
The rally followed Reliance's September-quarter results, which showed a 40.6% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, significantly ahead of analyst expectations. Stronger refining and petrochemical margins, alongside improved profitability at its telecom business Jio, helped drive the earnings growth.
The results reinforced investor confidence in Reliance's two major earnings engines - its oil-to-chemicals business and digital services - even as profitability in its retail business remained under pressure.
The company's refining core earnings surged 68%, while Jio Platforms' core earnings rose 16.6% during the quarter.
"Mukesh Ambani chairs and runs $125 billion (revenue) Reliance Industries, which has interests in petrochemicals, oil and gas, telecom, retail, media and financial services," Forbes said.
Reliance was founded by his late father Dhirubhai Ambani, a yarn trader, in 1966 as a small textile manufacturer. After his father's death in 2002, Ambani and his younger sibling, Anil, divided the family empire.
Reliance's telecom and broadband service Jio Platforms got listed in October 2026, achieving a market capitalisation of $137 billion, which made it the country's second-most valuable company after its parent.
Ambani's three children joined the board of Reliance in 2023. Son Akash heads Jio; daughter Isha oversees retail and financial services; and younger son Anant is in the energy business.
In 2026, Ambani announced plans for a $110 billion investment in AI infrastructure to be built across the country over the next seven years, the publication added.""

articles.title: Wie lange bekommt meine Fritzbox noch Updates? Diese Tabelle verrät es dir
articles.text:
Wie lange bekommt meine Fritzbox noch Updates? Diese Tabelle verrät es dir
Fast jedes Update bringt neue Funktionen auf Router, Repeater und andere Geräte von Fritz. Die FritzOS-Version 8.4o bringt etwa einen DNS-Filter auf Fritzboxen, mit dem sich bestimmte Werbeanzeigen, etwa auf Smart-TVs, ausblenden lassen. Die nächste Aktualisierung, FritzOS 8.50, steht auch schon für mehrere Router bereit. Doch wie lange geht das noch so? Nicht nur Smartphone-Besitzer:innen wissen, dass es irgendwann ein Ende hat mit dem Software-Support.
Bei Routern kann der besonders schwer wiegen, wenn kritische Sicherheitslücken nicht mehr geschlossen werden. Schon mehr als einmal hat ein Hersteller in diesem Fall zur Entsorgung geraten. Allerdings lässt sich schwer vorhersagen, wann ein Router oder entsprechendes Zubehör keine Updates mehr bekommt. Fritz hat deswegen für seine Kund:innen eine Liste veröffentlicht, die genau das beantwortet.
Fritz mit Software-Support bis in die 2030er
Die gute Nachricht: Wer ein halbwegs aktuelles Modell besitzt, muss sich in naher Zukunft keine Sorgen machen, plötzlich ohne Software-Updates darzustehen. Viele aktuelle Modelle unterstützt Fritz bis Anfang 2033. Seid ihr mit eurem jeweiligen WLAN-Standard zufrieden, braucht ihr euch also noch mindestens fünf Jahre keine Gedanken um einen Router-Neukauf zu machen. Bei einigen wenigen Modellen läuft dieser Updatezeitraum am 1. Januar oder Oktober 2032 aus. Selbst das ist aber mehr als genug Zeit, um sich Gedanken über das nächste Modell zu machen. articles.title: ChatGPT bientôt connecté à Google Health : l'IA s'attaque à vos données les plus intimes
articles.text:
Votre poids, votre cycle menstruel ou les informations sur votre activité sexuelle pourraient bientôt alimenter les réponses de ChatGPT sur Android. Des indices repérés dans l’application révèlent les préparatifs d’une connexion à Google Health qui permettrait de consulter ces données avec votre autorisation, y compris lorsque le chatbot d’OpenAI fonctionne en arrière-plan.
Les relevés de votre montre connectée pourraient bientôt alimenter ChatGPT sans passer par une capture d’écran ou un copier-coller. En examinant la version Android 1.2026.300, Android Authority a découvert plusieurs indices d’une future connexion à Google Health. OpenAI n’a toutefois pas annoncé cette intégration, qui n’est pas encore accessible.
Des permissions qui dépassent largement le nombre de pas
Les autorisations repérées permettraient de consulter le poids et la composition corporelle de l’utilisateur du smartphone, mais aussi des informations sur ses menstruations, son ovulation et son activité sexuelle. Ces données passeraient par Health Connect, le service d’Android qui permet aux applications de partager des informations de santé. Leur disponibilité dépendrait donc de ce qui y est enregistré, qu’il s’agisse de mesures automatiques en provenance d'une montre connectée ou d'un bracelet d'activité, mais aussi d’informations saisies par l’utilisateur.
L’appli ChatGPT se prépare également à lire un historique de données. Elle pourrait ainsi analyser des évolutions sur la durée. Plus sensible, la permission READ_HEALTH_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND autorise la consultation des informations même lorsque l’application n’est pas affichée à l’écran. Cela ne prouve toutefois pas qu’une collecte permanente soit prévue. Android exige en effet une autorisation supplémentaire de l’utilisateur pour permettre cette lecture en arrière-plan.
Des données mieux exploitées, des réglages à surveiller
ChatGPT Health propose déjà aux utilisateurs américains de rapprocher leurs données personnelles pour comprendre des résultats d’examens, suivre des tendances ou préparer un rendez-vous médical. OpenAI assure que les dossiers médicaux et les données Apple Santé connectés, ainsi que les conversations qui les utilisent, ne servent pas à entraîner ses modèles ni au ciblage publicitaire.
Le fonctionnement des permissions mérite néanmoins qu’on s’y attarde. Depuis le 14 septembre, les nouvelles connexions à Health suivent le réglage général des applications connectées. Si l’utilisateur conserve l’option par défaut, ChatGPT peut utiliser les informations déjà reliées à Health lorsqu’elles sont pertinentes sans demander une confirmation à chaque fois. Cette autorisation reste distincte de celles qu’Android réclamerait pour accéder aux données du téléphone. OpenAI note que plus de 70% des utilisateurs Health l’autorisent déjà.
OpenAI fait par ailleurs l’objet d’une plainte déposée en Californie après le décès de Bowen Wan, une femme épileptique qui vivait à Seattle. Ses parents accusent ChatGPT de l’avoir encouragée à réduire son traitement et estiment que ses conseils ont contribué à sa mort. Cette affaire concerne des échanges avec le chatbot, sans lien établi avec la future connexion à Google Health. La firme de Sam Altman précise dans sa documentation que Health est conçu pour accompagner les soins sans vocation à poser un diagnostic ou à proposer un traitement.
L’IA peut devenir une précieuse alliée pour notre santé. De là à lui confier notre dossier médical sans sourciller, il y a encore un pas.
- Chat dans différentes langues, dont le français
- Générer, traduire et obtenir un résumé de texte
- Générer, optimiser et corriger du code

articles.title: The 22GB GeForce RTX 2080 Ti mod is a fix for a problem most gamers don't have
articles.text:
In context: Graphics cards with more than 16GB of memory have only gotten more expensive this year, so it's no surprise that modders keep trying things like doubling the RTX 2080 Ti's VRAM to 22GB. A fresh round of benchmarks now shows what the upgrade actually buys on an 8-year-old GPU. The results suggest it mostly comes down to whether a workload was running out of memory in the first place.
When PC Games Hardware tested a 22GB card lent by a reader, it went looking for trouble on purpose. The outlet picked nine of the most memory-hungry games it knows and maxed them out. It also acknowledges that nearly every game it left out runs fine on the stock 11GB, which is good news for anyone still running a regular 2080 Ti.
Even in that hand-picked lineup, 1440p with DLSS Quality barely separated the two cards. Only Flight Simulator 2024 and Spider-Man 2 pushed past 11GB, since both stream huge open worlds, from Flight Simulator's globe-spanning scenery to Spider-Man 2's New York. In those two, the stock card ran about 20% slower and stuttered as it shuffled data into system RAM.
The gap only blew open once the outlet switched to 4K with DLSS Performance and FSR frame generation stacked on top. Flight Simulator 2024 jumped from 30 fps to 52 fps, while Indiana Jones and the Great Circle crashed to the desktop every time on the 11GB card.
Still, those are demanding settings for a card this old, and not every game ran smoothly even with the extra memory. So for gaming, the extra VRAM mostly decides whether a punishing setup runs at all, rather than making everyday settings any faster.
The outlet's AI image test pointed the same way at first. In its toughest scene, rewriting a prompt with a language model and rendering the first image took the 22GB card more than 200 seconds less than a factory-overclocked 11GB card. An RTX 5070 Ti with 16GB, however, finished the same job in about 85 seconds.
Part of the reason is that the newer card supports the compact FP8 format in hardware. Turing has to fall back on FP16, so the same model takes up far more memory. In practice, a newer card's 16GB can stretch further than an older card's 22GB.
That leaves the mod in a fairly narrow spot. Pre-modded cards from a Hong Kong eBay store have been selling for around $500. For that, buyers get an old card with a very loud blower cooler and a stranger's solder job. The outlet warned that sloppy soldering can cause faults that only show up weeks later.
The math looks kinder for people who already own a 2080 Ti and run workloads that simply need more room. A repair shop in Japan, for instance, will double an existing card's memory for about $282. That option may only get more tempting, too, since Zotac parent PC Partner expects entry-level graphics cards to get even tighter on supply as memory prices keep climbing.

articles.title: Y Combinator's Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan has, in the past, jokingly admitted that he’s suffered from “cyber psychosis” and sometimes barely sleeps because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast The Builders, set to publish on Tuesday, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
“I spend about maybe $100[,000] to $200,000 a year on tokens,” he told Isaacson. He uses agents for countless work projects and coding tasks and has freely shared his set of 23 Claude Code skills, called gstack, on GitHub — an effort to help teach others what agents can do, he said.
On the one hand, he uses his agent the way many people use AI: to help him research Isaacson’s podcast and prep for the kinds of questions he might be asked. On the other, his agent also helps him run his life.
“It’s read all of my email and all of my Dropbox. It’s read, like, all of my Apple Notes, even my therapy notes going back 20 years,” he said.
He describes using AI agents as getting help with “almost anything that you do in your day-to-day life, and for it to do it somewhat more autonomously. Think of it as a Jiminy Cricket on your shoulder at all times. Like, almost anything you want to do, it knows you, and it’s there to help. And it will actually sort of run ahead and say, ‘What about this?’ Or it’ll help you see around corners.”
As an early OpenClaw adopter who is now a power user, Tan says one thing he’s learned is not to treat AI agents like traditional software. Some people are so worried about “repeatability and safety that they actually trade off all of the beautiful parts of working with an AI agent, which basically can be so similar to a human,” he said.
For instance, Y Combinator is also using an agent that is “rebuilding the way we operate at YC,” he said. “We now have an internal AI agent, for instance, named Stray Light that kind of has a personality, and then it has a company brain. Like it actually has the total context of every founder we’ve ever backed, anyone who’s ever emailed us, like all the applications.”
Tan, who is, naturally, an avid lover of technology (as anyone running Silicon Valley’s famed startup accelerator would be), believes personal AI agents will eventually become mainstream, if one major problem is solved: Costs have got to come down.
“It’s too expensive right now,” he said, adding that he knows the amount of money he spends on AI agents is “a crazy privilege that not everyone can do.”
But freebie agents controlled by Big Tech maybe aren’t the answer, either. When discussing the future he’d like tech to build, and how Meta as a social media company has impacted us, he said, “This is a huge company that controls the algorithm, and we all wish that they didn’t at some level,” he said. “So you could imagine a personal AI that you control, that you program.”

articles.title: Anthropic’s quarterly revenue jumps to $17B, losses grow ahead of IPO - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Anthropic’s quarterly revenue jumps to $17B, losses grow ahead of IPO
Anthropic PBC today published an updated version of the S-1 filing for its upcoming public offering.
The original document, which the company released last Monday, didn’t contain its third-quarter financial results. The new version reveals that Anthropic generated $17 billion in revenue during the three months ended Sept. 30. That’s more than 11 times more than what it made a year earlier, but represents a deacceleration in quarter-over-quarter growth. Anthropic’s top line grew 47% on a quarterly basis, down from 144% three months earlier.
The artificial intelligence provider faces multipronged competition from open-source models, OpenAI Group PBC and tech giants such as Google LLC. The Alphabet Inc.’s newest model, Gemini 4 Carbon, outperforms Claude Opus 5.5 across multiple benchmarks.
Anthropic is investing heavily in training infrastructure to stay ahead of the competition. The company took a $5 billion charge in the third quarter because demand for computing hardware was higher than expected, which required it to purchase hardware at a premium. Hardware bought on short notice is more expensive than Anthropic’s usual capacity commitments, which it books 12 to 18 months before they’re needed.
The AI provider also took a $2 billion charge in connection with its non-cash employee donation matching program. That left Anthropic with a $536 million operating loss at the end of the third quarter. Three months earlier, it posted $974 million in operating income. Anthropic’s adjusted operating income, which excludes stock-based compensation and charitable contributions, jumped by $300 million on a quarterly basis to $2.5 billion.
The company had $895.4 billion in outstanding infrastructure commitments as of Sept 30. Leases signed with Google LLC and Broadcom Inc. accounted for nearly a third of that sum. In April, the two companies agreed to supply Anthropic with several gigawatts of computing power powered by the search giant’s TPU chips, which Broadcom helped design. The AI provider also has computing deals with Amazon.com Inc., Oracle Corp. and SpaceX Technologies Corp. that are each worth more than $100 billion.
Anthropic plans to not only rent more computing capacity but also build its own data centers. The company’s purchase commitments jumped from $55 billion at the end of 2025 to about $314 billion in the third quarter.
Alongside the new financial figures, Anthropic’s revised S-1 filing provides an update about its efforts to mitigate AI risks. According to the document, the company is considering “to require human review and approval of certain” research tasks that are currently performed automatically by its models. It believes that its models will soon be capable of “dramatically” accelerating AI development.
Anthropic hasn’t yet disclosed how much it plans to raise through its public offering. According to Bloomberg, the company hopes to at least match the $86.2 billion that SpaceX pulled in when it listed its shares earlier this year. Reuters reported that Anthropic is seeking a valuation of $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion.

articles.title: El director ejecutivo de Nvidia calculó en USD 2.000 por chip al año la licencia del software de agentes
articles.text:
El director ejecutivo de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, dijo que el software de la empresa para ejecutar agentes de IA cuesta alrededor de USD 2.000 por procesador gráfico (GPU) al año. Lo afirmó el 22 de octubre en GTC Berlín, la conferencia de la compañía, como ejemplo de cómo cobrará licencias en el futuro.
“Las licencias de software serán cada vez más una parte importante del negocio de nuestra empresa”, dijo Huang, según Tom’s Hardware, que citó un video de sus comentarios. Y agregó: “Por ejemplo, son unos 2.000 dólares por GPU al año para ejecutar todo el software que Nvidia ofrece para correr agentes en estas fábricas de IA”.
Los agentes son asistentes de IA que ejecutan tareas por su cuenta. Las “fábricas de IA” son el nombre que Nvidia da a los centros de datos construidos para ese trabajo. La frase de Huang fue publicada primero por The Register, según TechSpot y TechPowerUp.
Una cifra menor que el precio de lista actual
La compañía tecnológica ya vende un paquete de software empresarial llamado AI Enterprise. Según TechSpot, que cita la guía de licencias de la compañía, cuesta USD 4.500 por GPU para una suscripción de un año con soporte. La cifra de Huang es menos de la mitad.
El ejecutivo no aclaró si los USD 2.000 corresponden al mismo software, a un paquete más acotado centrado en agentes o a un modelo de licencias aún no anunciado. Tom’s Hardware advierte que la cifra no debe tomarse como una rebaja confirmada. Tampoco hay fecha de entrada en vigor. En tanto, la empresa tampoco confirmó formalmente la cifra, informó SDxCentral. Medios especializados la leen como una estimación de referencia y no como un precio de lista.
Huang dijo a la prensa, entre ella SDxCentral, que el negocio de software de Nvidia ya es “bastante significativo” y que supera “bien por encima de mil millones de dólares al año”. Según el ejecutivo, crecerá a medida que la IA llegue a más empresas.
Las grandes nubes, explicó, pueden operar su propia pila de software, y la empresa les licencia el código o se lo entrega abierto. Muchas otras compañías, en cambio, no tienen un departamento de tecnología capaz de hacerlo. “Necesitan saber que yo soy responsable del contrato de servicio”, afirmó.
Para dimensionar la cifra, TechSpot calculó que cada millón de GPU con licencia aportaría USD 2.000 millones anuales. Eso es poco frente a los USD 96.200 millones que Nvidia facturó en su último trimestre informado, según el mismo medio, pero son ingresos que no dependen de vender chips nuevos.
El comentario llegó un día después de que la firma tecnológica presentara su arquitectura de referencia OpenShell, que combina chips Vera Rubin y Vera con procesadores BlueField-4 para vigilar a los agentes y aislarlos si exceden sus permisos. Según Tom’s Hardware, Anthropic integra OpenShell con su servicio Claude Managed Agents, y Salesforce desarrolló una herramienta para administrar permisos de agentes desde Slack.
Huang ya había planteado la idea de que Nvidia es algo más que un fabricante de chips. En el pódcast BG2Pod dijo que “uno de estos días” la gente podría dejar de clasificarla como una empresa de chips. La empresa aun no informó cuándo detallará el esquema de licencias ni qué productos incluirá.

articles.title: Steam Hardware Survey: Old Leaders Return as 16 GB RAM and RTX 3060 Are Back on Top
articles.text:
Monday, November 2nd 2026
Steam Hardware Survey: Old Leaders Return as 16 GB RAM and RTX 3060 Are Back on Top
Valve's October 2026 Steam Hardware & Software Survey shows much of September's odd data snapping back. After 32 GB system RAM overtook 16 GB last month, the 16 GB tier is back in first place at 41.42% (up 3.60 points), while 32 GB dropped 5.16 points to 37.06%. The GeForce RTX 3060 is the most common GPU again at 3.62% across all platforms, a spot it held before September, while the RTX 5070 fell from 5.86% to 3.56%. It looks like the survey sample played a big part. Simplified Chinese fell 9.41 points to 21.98%, while English rose 4.84 points to 39.04%. The survey is voluntary, so a change in who responds can move the numbers without an actual hardware change behind it. We can't confirm that, but it would explain why so many categories shifted at once. 
Windows 11 rose 1.17 points to 72.51%, and Linux climbed 0.90 points to 3.95%. The 1440p share dropped 5.22 points to 21.82%, while 1080p sits at 50.23%. On Windows, Intel gained 0.89 points to reach 53.48% CPU share, with AMD at 46.51%. Valve's Steam Frame, which launched in September, now holds 4.13% of surveyed VR headsets, up 3.72 points, while Meta Quest 3 continues to dominate with a 27.27% share. However, headset owners are only 1.75% of the survey, so it's a small group. The interesting bit is still the system RAM split, and while 32 GB RAM had been slowly gaining on 16 GB, it looks like September was the outlier. November's data should give us a better idea of the split.

articles.title: Spotify is reportedly pushing ahead with its AI remixing feature in early 2027 — but some users are labelling it as 'horrible' and 'gross'
articles.text:
'Who wants this?': Spotify's AI-powered remix and covers feature is tipped for a February launch, but it could cost you $5 extra — and users aren't happy
A few more details have emerged
- Spotify's AI remixing tool is tipped to arrive early in 2027
- Premium users may have to pay $4–$5 extra for it
- Reaction from potential users has been lukewarm
Back in August, Spotify announced plans to introduce new AI-powered features to let users create custom covers and remixes of their songs, and a new rumor suggests the feature may arrive in February — at the cost of a $4–$5 surcharge on top of existing Premium subscriptions.
That's according to the Financial Times (via Android Authority), which reports that "people familiar" with the plans reckon a launch could be scheduled to coincide with the Grammys — the music awards show is on Sunday, February 7 — or could happen on some other date within the first quarter of 2027.
Spotify is apparently still trying to get artists and labels to embrace the technology, which would (for example) let you turn a dance track in your library into a country ballad, or have one of your favorite artists cover a song recorded by a different singer or band.
It's worth bearing in mind that these details are still to be confirmed, as, per the FT, the timing and pricing have not been finalized, though we know from what Spotify has already said that it's keen to push this new feature out.
Winning over artists and fans
The plan seems to be to reward artists who let Spotify use their music for AI purposes, and one analyst quoted by the FT estimates that 7–8% of US Premium subscribers (of whom there are thought to be around 75 million) would pay the extra few dollars for the feature.
"Winning over major contemporary stars has proved more challenging than securing participation from some established older artists," says the FT — with Olivia Rodrigo mentioned as one of the artists who have previously taken a public anti-AI stance.
If the Reddit boards are any indication of feeling, there's not much of an appetite for these new AI tools among users either. One thread responding to the FT report is filled with negative comments and recommendations for alternative music streaming services.

"Who wants this?" is indicative of the comments, while the words "gross" and "horrible" are also thrown around. Spotify doesn't, of course, have to convince all of its users to adopt the AI add-on to make it profitable; but as this report suggests, getting artists on board might be the bigger issue.

articles.title: Un robot de reparto provoca un accidente con nueve heridos en Tallin y sigue su camino: técnicamente, es un conductor a la fuga
articles.text:
Eran casi las seis de la tarde en una concurrida vía del centro de Tallin por la que circulaba un autobús urbano lleno de pasajeros. De repente, algo se cruzó en el camino y el conductor se vio obligado a dar un frenazo brusco que mandó al suelo a varios pasajeros que iban de pie. Quien lo provocó siguió tranquilamente su camino sin mirar atrás.
El culpable de este incidente no tiene ni carnet de conducir ni DNI: es un robot de reparto autónomo que cruzó la calle con el semáforo en rojo y causó el accidente. Ahora la policía de Estonia lo investiga, y Europa se topa con una pregunta para la que todavía no tiene una respuesta clara: ¿quién responde cuando el causante de un accidente es una máquina autónoma?
Un cruce en rojo y nueve heridos. Según informaba la empresa municipal de transporte TLT, el lunes 26 de octubre, un robot de reparto autónomo de Bolt llegó a un paso de peatones y, sin pensárselo dos veces, cruzó la calle con el semáforo en rojo. El conductor de un autobús que circulaba con el semáforo en verse, se vio obligado a frenar de golpe. Como consecuencia, varios pasajeros que iban de pie cayeron y hasta nueve personas resultaron heridas a causa de la caída.
El vídeo del autobús muestra el choque y cómo el robot es empujado por la calzada para luego seguir su camino como si nada hubiese sucedido. Andrei Novikov, directivo de TLT, afirmó al medio local ERR que "el robot se dio a la fuga, por así decirlo". Un portavoz añadió que irse del lugar sin cumplir con la ley "puede constituir un delito".
La versión del fabricante. Pepe Aaviksoo, jefe de operaciones de Starship, la empresa que diseña estos robots, explicó que era de noche y que tras el semáforo había un anuncio luminoso, lo cual dificultó el reconocimiento de la luz del paso de peatones. Además, las luces del semáforo de peatones y las de los coches estaban en la misma línea de visión. El responsable reconoció el fallo en la sensibilidad a la luz del robot. "Hay muchas lecciones que aprender, pero las situaciones excepcionales ocurren", recogió ERR News.
Sin embargo, Starship niega la fuga. Según Aaviksoo, el robot esperó unos 10 minutos en las inmediaciones del incidente y avisó a su equipo de soporte que debía apartarlo de la carretera. Para él, "la situación era clara, como lo demuestra el hecho de que el autobús abandonó el lugar". Dice que sus empleados no vieron ni policía ni servicios sanitarios.
Un vacío legal que Europa no ha cerrado. Esta situación, que por el momento es poco menos que anecdótica, presenta un nuevo reto para la normativa europea, ahora que sus calles comienzan a llenarse con coches autónomos y otros vehículos de reparto: ¿quién paga cuando no hay conductor?
En lo que se refiere a la responsabilidad civil, la UE tiene la nueva directiva de productos defectuosos, que trata el software y la IA como productos. Sin embargo, esta legislación solo se aplicará a los productos comercializados a partir del 9 de diciembre de 2026, así que los robots autónomos que ya circulan por Tallin y otras ciudades europeas siguen bajo la norma de 1985.
La Comisión retiró la directiva de responsabilidad de daños por la IA, normativa que podría englobar los daños producidos por estos sistemas de conducción autónoma. El eurodiputado Axel Voss, que la tutelaba, dijo a Euronews que fue un "error estratégico".
En lo penal, cada país va a lo suyo. Por suerte, el incidente de Estonia no tuvo mayores consecuencias para los pasajeros. Pero de haberlas sufrido, la vía penal es otro terreno. La UE solo puede fijar reglas mínimas para delitos graves de una lista concreta, así que irse de un siniestro se castiga según la legislación de cada país.
Desde 2017, la ley de tráfico de Estonia incluye a los robots de reparto autónomo y trata a su poseedor como a un conductor. Es decir, si el robot pertenece a una plataforma de reparto de última milla, como Bolt, a efectos legales sería responsabilidad de la compañía, y debe contar con un seguro de responsabilidad para cubrir los daños que puedan derivarse de un accidente. Si es la propia empresa que lo fabrica es la propietaria y lo ofrece como un servicio a las plataformas (como un renting), entonces esa responsabilidad recaería sobre el fabricante.
Cada vez hay más robots en la calle. El caso del accidente de Tallin justo en un momento en el que cada vez hay más servicios de entrega autónoma a domicilio, y justo cuando se están aprobando las primeras pruebas de conducción autónomas en ciudades como Madrid.
Starship anunció en junio más de 10 millones de entregas y más de 3.000 robots en 300 ubicaciones de ocho países. Uber Eats, que ya los usa en Leeds y prevé sumar más países europeos en 2026. En España, Zaragoza estrenó los suyos en 2022 con Goggo Network. Su consejera de Movilidad, Natalia Chueca, dijo que no hacía falta cambiar las normas porque los robots "no son vehículos". En Estonia, la ley sí los trata como tales y deben asumir las mismas responsabilidades que cualquier conductor cuando se saltan los semáforos en rojo.

articles.title: OYO parent PRISM’s revenue rises 35% to Rs 2,814 Cr in Q1 FY27
articles.text:
OYO parent PRISM’s revenue rises 35% to Rs 2,814 Cr in Q1 FY27
PRISM's hotel segment bookings grew 30% year-on-year, while the vacation homes business recorded 28% growth in bookings.
IPO-bound PRISM, parent entity of hospitality chain OYO, has posted a consolidated profit after tax (PAT) of Rs 353 crore in the first quarter ended June, registering 17% growth from Rs 301 crore in the year-ago period.
The quarterly profit included a deferred-tax credit of approximately Rs 244 crore, according to the company's audited financials.
PRISM's revenue from operations increased 35% to Rs 2,814 crore in the first quarter of FY2026-27, compared with Rs 2,078 crore in the corresponding quarter last year, the audited financials showed.
The company's Gross Booking Value grew 30% to nearly Rs 9,600 crore in the same period.
Growth was broad-based across its hotels and vacation homes businesses.
PRISM's hotel segment bookings grew 30% year-on-year, while the vacation homes business recorded 28% growth in bookings.
Addressing shareholders at the company's Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) in early October, PRISM Founder Ritesh Agarwal said, "What is encouraging is that this momentum has continued into the first quarter of FY27. Our performance across hotels and vacation homes has demonstrated improving gross margins and higher operating earnings, even as we invest in expanding our brands and strengthening customer demand."
"We are continuing to grow our business while generating healthy operating earnings. We are seeing the benefits of the investments we have made over the past few years in technology, brands and distribution capabilities, while continuing to invest quite aggressively," he had said.
In his EGM address, Agarwal highlighted the importance of the company's geographically diversified business, with North America remaining a key market following the acquisition of G6 Hospitality. He said G6 alone contributed approximately Rs 14,000 crore in Gross Booking Value during FY26.
Other profitability indicators also strengthened in the June quarter: EBITDA rose 24% year-on-year to Rs 760 crore, while adjusted EBITDA, net of lease expenses, increased 35% to Rs 589 crore.
Its common technology platform is built centrally and replicated across markets, supporting pricing, distribution, reservations, customer service and property management. PRISM is also embedding AI in pricing and workflows; its Grace AI general manager supports operations at several hotels in Western markets.
Separately, an October 26 addendum filed with SEBI cut the proposed IPO fresh issue to up to Rs 3,350 crore and earmarked Rs 2,512.5 crore for repayment or prepayment of borrowings through a subsidiary, while removing the proposed pre-IPO placement.
With inputs from PTI.

articles.title: Anthropic ne veut plus que Claude copie des jeux vidéo
articles.text:
Depuis l’arrivée de Claude Sonnet 5.5, tout va plus vite : ce modèle d’IA fait tout plus vite, plus efficacement et pour moins cher. Un modèle parfait pour créer des jeux vidéo, ou bien pour les copier. Et c’est justement ce qu’Anthropic ne veut plus permettre : l’entreprise a mis à jour Claude sans le dire pour empêcher des utilisateurs de copier des jeux vidéo qui ne leur appartiennent pas.
Deux phrases qui changent tout : comment Anthropic veut bloquer son Claude
C’est un utilisateur du nom de chasm qui a repéré le changement, comme il l’a expliqué sur X. Il raconte que Claude Code (la version du chatbot dédiée au développement informatique) aurait reçu une nouvelle règle « autour du 27 octobre ». Une règle qui, contrairement à d’autres, ne peut être désactivée. Il est écrit : « Crée des jeux originaux, des jeux dans un genre, et des jeux à partir des propres designs et assets de l’utilisateur. Ne crée pas une récréation d’un jeu existant spécifique, même s’il est renommé ou qualifié d’original. »
 ANTHROPIC IS CRACKING DOWN ON VIDEO GAME REWRITES 🚨
Claude Code picked up a new rule around Oct 27, sent from Anthropic’s servers under a flag called "tengu_heron_brook". There’s no setting to turn it off.
The full rule: “Do build original games, games in a genre, and games… pic.twitter.com/0Zc5mQWHJt
— chasm (@chasmmmmmmmmmmm) October 30, 2026
Suite à ce tweet, un membre de l’équipe technique d’Anthropic, Addy Osmani, a donné une justification : « utiliser Claude pour enfreindre la propriété intellectuelle va à l’encontre de notre politique d’utilisation. » Mais il l’assure, « les jeux originaux, les jeux de genre et les jeux construits à partir de vos propres designs et assets sont censés continuer de fonctionner. » Sans le dire, Anthropic s’assure aussi de ne pas se faire attaquer en justice par des éditeurs de jeux vidéo qui accuseraient l’entreprise d’avoir laissé les utilisateurs de Claude Code de plagier leurs jeux.
 We added two sentences to Claude Code's prompt on Opus 5.5 to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game because using Claude to infringe IP is against our usage policy.
Original games, genre games, and games built from your own designs and assets are meant to…
— Addy Osmani (@addyosmani) October 30, 2026
Sur X cependant, plusieurs internautes pointent du doigt cette situation risible, en ce sens qu’Anthropic elle-même est accusée de violation du droit d’auteur. Anthropic avait par exemple trouvé un accord à 1,5 milliard de dollars après avoir été accusée d’avoir « pillé » environ sept millions de livres pour entraîner Claude. Même chose début 2026 : une plainte a été déposée par des éditeurs de morceaux musicaux. Ils accusent Anthropic d’avoir utilisé sans autorisation plus de 20 000 chansons afin d’entraîner son IA.
La fin des jeux vidéo et du modding avec IA ?
Anthropic a pris cette décision dans un contexte plutôt sensible : il y a quelques semaines, l’entreprise avait lancé Claude Sonnet 5.5, son tout dernier modèle, arrivé dans Claude Code. Et depuis quelques semaines, des dizaines de jeux sont décompilés à tour de bras, récents comme anciens, pour les faire fonctionner dans un autre langage par exemple. Ces décompilations permettent ensuite de faire ce qu’on veut avec : les faire tourner directement dans un navigateur (et gratuitement), les porter sur n’importe quel appareil, les modifier, ou même les mélanger.
Par exemple, on a vu Minecraft « tourner » de pair avec GTA V et plein d’autres jeux. Ce qui pose un énorme problème en matière de propriété intellectuelle : tous ces usages ne sont pas permis par les éditeurs de ces titres. Même chose avec les logiciels : un utilisateur a recréé les suites d’Adobe et de Microsoft dans des versions totalement gratuites.
L’entreprise tente donc de stopper l’hémorragie avec cette nouvelle règle, qui doit empêcher ces décompilations et détournements, qui sont techniquement des recréations faites avec Claude Code. Parfois en quelques heures et avec des compétences techniques requises de moins en moins grandes au fur et à mesure que les méthodes se partagent sur Internet.
